tasks.short: Provide follow-up consultations on developing landscapes.

steps.what: Read the agreed landscape design, planting intent and prior follow-up findings before the client consultation
Inspect actual landscape maturation, plant establishment, drainage and maintenance conditions against the design intent
Provide follow-up consultations for clients, explain how the landscape is developing and discuss appropriate maintenance or design responses
Write and check the actual follow-up note and client advice in {PROJECT}, reusing project identity and design revision
Save the checked follow-up advice in {PROJECT}
Send the checked advice to the designated client using {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Configure the existing follow-up note in {PROJECT} to reuse project identity and the agreed design revision. The architect reads the plan, assesses actual landscape development and gives the advice; the small writing benefit concerns headers only, followed by separate human save and client send.
tasks.previous_blocker: The follow-up note can repeat project identity and design revision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project-linked fields can reuse these identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing normal establishment from poor maintenance, unsuitable planting or a design problem.
tasks.human_edge: Site judgement and explaining practical responses to the client.

ambition.what: No extra follow-up service or remote assessment is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated note setup, unchanged design responsibility.

reach.task: Explain design intent behind maintenance advice

evidence.claim: Project-linked note fields can reuse identifiers, while assessing actual landscape development and advising clients remain professional work.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual follow-up consultation, inspection and its existing note and written advice. No large visit-preparation, scheduling or photography baseline is invented. A purely verbal consultation has no writing saving.

Project administration supplies project ID, client identity and agreed drawing revision. The architect supplies actual observations, advice and unresolved questions in s2-s4; capture remains fully counted. Missing revision or site evidence is resolved manually, not inferred from the plan.

Native fields first. Only repeated headers in s4 lose time; plant inspection, interpretation, client discussion and substantive writing remain. Existing image-analysis capabilities in the digest do not establish a plant-establishment assessment saving.

The normal completed-advice check in s4 covers content, exact client recipient and purpose. Any edit voids both action references. Ordinary save and send retain full effort; no additional self-approval step is introduced. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Whether identity fields are already linked and whether written follow-up is routine.
research_questions: Does native field reuse remove any actual repeated writing without carrying an obsolete design revision?

already_counted.description: Plan reading, actual landscape assessment and client consultation remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final follow-up advice checked in s4; edits require recheck.
Exact advice and designated client recipient checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10% less time in the 13-share writing step saves 1.3 points less 0.3 upkeep. Low is project headers already linked or a verbal-only follow-up; no inspection or conversation benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain site-based follow-up judgement with slightly less repeated note entry.
reach: Help maintenance managers understand landscape design intent.
role.ambitious_version: A landscape architect whose follow-up advice clearly links observed conditions to the agreed design.
